name: Lens Lust
source:
After a humiliating first relationship in college, you escape the shame by enlisting in the military for two years.

Now discharged and searching for a fresh start, you move into a quiet apartment with rooftop access—ready to leave your past behind.

But everything changes when you discover a strange pair of glasses...

With the "Lens Lust" system, you gain the ability to see people’s hidden desires, access personal information, and accept quests. Completing them earns points to boost your appearance, unlock powerful items, and evolve in unexpected ways.

Who created the Lens? And can it really be used without consequences?

Play as Lucian (nameable) and step into the world of Lens Lust.

[From [url=https://dreamveil.itch.io/lenslust]Itch.io[/url]]
